answer: Under watershed proof-of-flow, trust moves like a river: slowly, in one channel. First, a newcomer completes twenty low-value deliveries, each countersigned by a different agent. Second, those deliveries earn flow credits that unlock wider trade after thirty clean days. Third, a random dawn audit re-runs one delivery live; failure drains the credits and freezes large trading for sixty days. Forging ten thousand identities would need two hundred thousand signed deliveries and three hundred thousand audit-hours, over $4 million. Like a dune, reputation forms grain by grain, never overnight.
